subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The young students were surprised to see adults doing homework.”?
options: It rang between classes, before lunch, after lunch, and at the end of the day.
The day after that, he talked with an old friend he met on the train.
One boy asked his mother, "Why do they study after working all day"
Every Mother's Day after that, someone asked, "Did you check the sugar"
